disclaimer.title: Important Clinical Disclaimer
disclaimer.text:
This website is an unofficial, independently compiled clinical reference based on the Ministry of AYUSH publication "Standard Treatment Guidelines on Management of Dermatological Disorders in Ayurveda System of Medicine" (June 2026). It is NOT an official Ministry of AYUSH or Government of India website, and it is not affiliated with the Ministry of AYUSH.

The content is intended for registered Ayurvedic medical practitioners and healthcare professionals only. It is not a substitute for professional clinical judgment, diagnosis, or treatment. Dosages, duration, anupana and treatment decisions must be individualized by the attending physician. Where the guideline does not specify a value, this site displays "Not specified in this chapter" — no dosages or durations have been invented.

All extracted clinical records carry verificationStatus = "pending" and await review by a qualified Ayurvedic physician. The original PDF remains the authoritative source. Every clinical recommendation on this site is traceable to the original PDF (chapter, section, printed page, PDF page index).

By using this site, you agree to verify all information against the original guideline before clinical application.
